purpose: Genuine synthetic password/TOTP login, native signed-token admission, app scope, permission withdrawal, provider back-channel logout, provider signing-key rotation, HTTP cookie/header policy and real session expiry. This file does not authorize launch.

limits.proposed_growth_includes: Docker startup, reviewed image/wheel downloads and native execution from a captured pre-stage free-disk baseline. Whole-host decrease is conservative, not attributable project usage.

isolation: Dedicated internal network; no published ports, runtime internet, shared host folders outside the reviewed run, Docker socket, privileged mode or host PID/IPC namespace.

Keycloak and runner share only this lab network namespace because the issuer, token endpoint and back-channel callback are fixed loopback origins. They retain separate filesystems, users and process namespaces.
Separate fresh PostgreSQL databases and non-superuser roles. PostgreSQL transport is plaintext inside this internal component network; it is not production database transport assurance.

Non-root components, removed Linux capabilities, no-new-privileges, resource limits, finite logs and no automatic restarts. Keycloak standard-image augmentation needs its own disposable writable root filesystem; console/database roots are read-only.
Distinct two-hour TLS server certificates for provider127.0.0.2 and console127.0.0.1, explicit per-process CA trust, no host trust-store change.
Fresh synthetic passwords and BASE32-encoded SHA256 TOTP seeds; no employer or personal identities. Explicit issuer/subject local provisioning; no provider role-to-admin mapping.
required_before_any_launch: The October3 single approved attempt stopped at Docker startup before containers. Review the startup environment correction and independent pre-engine shutdown, then obtain fresh authorization; do not retry automatically.
Complete current-source verification and root review; this proposal itself grants no authority.
Obtain owner approval for the exact pinned Keycloak image, Docker Desktop startup and this three-container native stage. Earlier library and Wazuh approvals do not authorize it.

Capture free disk before Docker startup/downloads, enforce the 4 GiB whole-stage guard and conservative 30 GiB milestone guard, recheck 25 GiB disk/4 GiB host-memory reserves, and require at least 7 GiB available host memory before creating the 3 GiB container profile.
Stop before native launch if cached PostgreSQL/Python images are absent or unrelated containers are running. No replacement downloads, other-project shutdown or automatic second attempt.
Validate installed image configuration and actual runtime facts, private credentials, watchdog and runner kernel gate. No host trust-store change, published port or external runtime network.
Reconcile all declared controls with retained native results and both shutdown receipts. Preserve failed or partial stages as incomplete.
host_controls: Private ACL-protected fresh run with source and dependency hashes, exact pinned images, effective Docker runtime/resource validation and retained observations.

Runner Linux UID/GID, capabilities, seccomp, cgroups and mount restrictions checked before release. Database and Keycloak kernel state remains Docker-metadata evidence, not an independent kernel probe.

Independent process watchdog, fixed 30-minute deadline, shared abort marker, scoped repeated stopping and bounded 60-second late-operation drain. Unreachable daemon or incomplete shutdown remains unverified.

No-run preflight rejects private files in publishable paths; post-generation scan compares publishable content against only this run's generated credentials. It is not a transformed-secret or database-volume scanner.
remaining_identity_acceptance: All16 wheels are now cached and hash-verified. The Keycloak image was not downloaded in the stopped attempt. Native acceptance remains unestablished.
This native HTTP stage is unrun; offline driver/controller checks are not genuine login or MFA.
A real browser walkthrough remains required; HTTP form driving does not prove SameSite behavior, keyboard access or UI.
Native cryptographic hostile-token controls beyond malformed input, provider key rotation and prepared PostgreSQL identity races remain separate requirements.
Synthetic identity-role fixtures are not source observations or verified remediation. Genuine source/retest and independent reviewer workflow remain separate gates.
